name: Ayush Pratap Singh
headline: Hi, I'm Ayush.
intro: I'm a computer science graduate with a product-first mindset. I write PRDs, run user research and build prototypes to test my ideas, using AI tools to move faster. Below are the problems I've worked on.
about: At IIT Ropar I owned an Android real-time data monitoring app from PRD to a tested release, fixing 5+ critical bugs and cutting the crash rate by 30%. I led a team of four on EchoShield, an AI voice deepfake detector, and I'm now writing product case studies on real problems. I graduated in 2026 with a B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering from IMS Engineering College, Ghaziabad.
